title: Record Metadata
description: Per-data-file metadata for an individual recording within a neuroimaging dataset. A data file is a primary recording (e.g., .set, .edf, .vhdr) along with its BIDS sidecar context. Each record has its own modality (required) and can override dataset-level signal properties via signal_properties.

dataset.description: Parent dataset identifier (foreign key to dataset.dataset_id).

data_name.description: Human-readable name for this data file (e.g., 'ds002718_sub-004_task-FaceRecognition_eeg.set').

bids_relpath.description: BIDS-compliant relative path within the dataset (e.g., 'sub-004/eeg/sub-004_task-FaceRecognition_eeg.set').

modality.description: Recording modality for this file (e.g., 'EEG', 'MEG', 'MRI', 'iEEG', 'EMG'). Required per record; not inherited from dataset.

file_extension.description: File extension including the leading dot (e.g., '.set', '.edf', '.vhdr', '.fif').
